title: Jibhi, Jalori & Tirthan Valley
reportingPoint: Pickup is from Delhi or Chandigarh. Departure is in the evening; the exact pickup point and time are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.
highlights: Choiee Waterfall trek in Tirthan Valley
Raghupur Fort trek with 360° views over Kullu and Mandi
Bonfire and music party in the valley
overview:
Two treks, one mountain pass and zero crowds: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Jibhi, Jalori and Tirthan Valley group trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh on Friday evening and gets you back early on Tuesday morning.

Day 1 reaches Jibhi (about 1,450 m) and sets off by noon on the Choiee Waterfall trek in Tirthan Valley, ending with a bonfire and music party. Day 2 goes over Jalori Pass (about 3,100 m) via Shoja for the Raghupur Fort trek, with its 360° view of the Kullu and Mandi region, and a café stop in Shoja if time allows. Day 3 is for Jibhi Waterfall and Mini Thailand before the drive home. A Jibhi-Tirthan hotel, travel by AC Tempo Traveller or bus, 4 meals and a tour curator are included. Prices start at ₹6,500 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra), and you reserve with a ₹3,000 advance.

itinerary.title: Departure to Jibhi (Friday evening)
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh and meet your trip captain and group.
Depart in the evening for Jibhi, with a halt for dinner on the way (not included).
Overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Choiee Waterfall trek (Saturday)
itinerary.content:
Reach Jibhi, check in at the hotel and rest.
By noon, set off for the Choiee Waterfall trek in Tirthan Valley.
Back at the stay for a bonfire and music party.
Dinner and overnight stay in Jibhi.

itinerary.title: Raghupur Fort trek, Jalori Pass and Shoja (Sunday)
itinerary.content:
Early start. After breakfast, depart for Jalori Pass via Shoja.
Trek to Raghupur Fort for a 360° view of the entire Kullu and Mandi region.
A 1-2 hour halt in Shoja village to explore its famous cafés and viewpoints (if time allows).
Back to the stay for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Jibhi exploration and departure (Monday)
itinerary.content:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel.
Spend time at Jibhi Waterfall and Mini Thailand: valley views and a riverside walk.
Depart in the evening and reach Delhi early on Tuesday morning.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Pickup is from Delhi or Chandigarh on Friday evening, with a dinner halt on the way (not included). The exact pickup point and time are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip. You reach Jibhi on Saturday morning and are back in Delhi early on Tuesday.

faqs.q: How much does the Jibhi, Jalori & Tirthan trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹6,500 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,000 on triple sharing and ₹7,500 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

A 2-night hotel stay in Jibhi - Tirthan, an AC Tempo Traveller or bus to and from depending on group size, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, all sightseeing in the itinerary, a bonfire and music party, a tour curator throughout, and extra mattresses for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: Which treks are part of the trip?
faqs.a: Day 1 has the Choiee Waterfall trek in Tirthan Valley, and Day 2 has the Raghupur Fort trek from Jalori Pass (about 3,100 m). Wear running or outdoor shoes with good grip.

faqs.q: Are entry tickets and a 4x4 included?
faqs.a: No. Entry tickets to viewpoints and the cost of a 4x4 vehicle, if one is needed, are not included.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pay a ₹3,000 per person advance to reserve your seat, by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, and clear the balance 24 hours before boarding. By paying the advance you accept the terms and conditions. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances, and there are no refunds for inclusions you don't use. Bookings can't be transferred: only the names given at confirmation may travel.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Nights are cold, so pack a down jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, running or outdoor shoes for the treks and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
